description: The signed-in driver's saved vehicles (up to 5 plates, each with an optional label) and plates from their past parking that aren't saved yet. action list (the default) only reads; save adds a plate or sets its label, rename changes a label, remove deletes a saved plate. Saving or removing the same plate twice changes nothing. A saved plate works as reserve's plate. Requires driver sign-in to Park Graph through this connector; without sign-in the call returns SIGN_IN_REQUIRED with the sign-in page. Every payment completes on parkgraph.com with the driver present; no tool charges money on its own.

label.description: A name for the vehicle, for save and rename ("Work truck")

plate.description: The plate, for save, rename and remove (spaces and dashes are ignored)

name: my_vehicles
title: My vehicles
